prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original animated pixel-art combat VFX sprite sheet, separate from inventory icons.
Primary request: ONE sprite sheet with exactly FOUR chronological animation frames in a single horizontal row of four equal isolated cells. Each frame is a distinct keyframe of the same effect: anticipation / activation / strong impact / dissipating. No text, numbering, labels, cell outlines or grid. Use a wide transparent canvas. Each logical cell is 64×64 pixels, enlarged with crisp square pixels. Clear empty gutters prevent adjacent-cell overlap. Keep common baseline and center across frames and preserve the size progression rather than filling every cell equally.
Subject: Three crisp ivory-white claw slash arcs. Four stages: first tiny cut, full sequential three-curved cuts, crossing bright impact shards, fading broken arc tips. Sharp dark contour, no actual claw or paw.
